title: PLO Ship 1: New Provider Account Setup

directions.name: Linear Checklist
directions.description: Bet that providers move fastest when the entire onboarding pipeline is visible as a locked checklist, so they always know how far they are and what unlocks next, without any ambiguity about sequence.

directions.name: One Step at a Time
directions.description: Bet that showing providers only their current step — with no visibility of future steps — reduces cognitive load and prevents providers from skipping ahead or feeling overwhelmed by the full pipeline.

directions.name: Dashboard with Stage Transparency
directions.description: Bet that giving providers a persistent portal home — showing their current Provider Onboarding Stage, what the team is doing on their behalf, and their Combined Member List alongside setup — reduces anxiety and support requests by making the pipeline legible from both sides.
